name: Cheryl Hulme
background: Cheryl Hulme is a Rawlins, Carbon County resident (mailing city on the candidate filing) who ran as the Constitution Party nominee for House District 15 and lost the Nov. 3, 2026 general election (21.0% of the vote), as already recorded from official results.

She was listed as the Constitution Party speaker for House District 15 at a Carbon County Higher Education Center general-election forum. A new search of public sources for this fill did not find an occupation, education, or military record.
